repos_data.description: Open-source MCP server for AI agents: read across 43 ad platforms, with verified write and create across 16 core platforms (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Reddit, TikTok, X, Amazon, TTD, DV360, StackAdapt & more). Free reads (zsh/mo), /mo Solo for writes, multi-tenant OAuth & REST/SDKs.
Governed, read-only MCP server for sell-side ad inventory discovery. AI buyer agents get coarse availability forecasts and product families — nothing sensitive, nothing writable, everything audited.
